description: Na₅MgSbO₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.54 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.81 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.42 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.46 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.42 Å. Mg is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.10 Å. Sb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.65 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to four Na and one Sb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Mg atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom.
